metadata.technology_specification: Modern digital flow cytometer with multi-laser optical system
metadata.technology_reasoning: Modern flow cytometers widely used in clinical and research labs feature multi-laser excitation sources and multiple photodetectors to track fluorescence and light scatter signals from cells or particles with high throughput and sensitivity. This is the dominant type due to versatility and multiplexing capability, representing the majority of flow cytometer sales as of 2024.

components.reasoning: Core system responsible for transporting and hydrodynamically focusing cells or particles in a fluid stream through the interrogation point, universally present and critical for proper flow cytometry operation.
Provide the multi-wavelength light needed to excite fluorophores on labeled cells; multiple lasers are standard for modern instruments, and lasers are procured as discrete components.
Includes photomultiplier tubes (PMTs) or photodiodes and optical filters used to detect scattered light and emitted fluorescence, a complex proprietary subassembly typically sourced as a module.
Dedicated subsystem to introduce samples into the fluidics path, standard separate unit especially in automated and high-throughput instruments.
Processes analog signals from photodetectors into digital data, essential electronics module generally integrated on specialized circuit boards.
Includes display screen and input controls (touchscreen or buttons), typically a modular electronics assembly that is provided separately from core optical/electronic systems.
Protective housing and mechanical structure that supports all components; standard manufacturing assembly purchased or manufactured separately.
